# Instrument family: five starter presets

**Parent:** TF-0MV9PIBNV008C00R (Playable MIDI instruments)
**Type:** feature

## Goal

Ship the starter instrument family — at least five purpose-crafted,
schema-valid, registered presets (pluck, pad, bass, bell, string-like lead)
that render deterministic, non-silent audio.

## Acceptance Criteria

- At least five instrument presets exist (e.g. `pluck`, `pad`, `bass`, `bell`,
  `string-lead`), each schema-valid per `src/instruments/schema.ts`.
- Presets live in a discoverable location (`src/instruments/presets/` or
  `presets/instruments/*.yaml` — consistent with the recipe-preset convention)
  and are registered in the instrument registry exported from
  `src/instruments/index.ts`.
- Presets are discoverable via the public API (e.g. `listInstruments()` /
  registry lookup) and each declares an id/name/category and distinct
  ADSR/oscillator values (pluck must differ observably from pad in envelope
  shape).
- An offline-render snapshot test per preset verifies deterministic,
  non-silent audio for a given seed, at the expected pitch and velocity.
- The five required presets are present and each renders a non-silent, distinct
  output.

**Key Files:**

- `src/instruments/presets/pluck.yaml` (new; plus the other four presets,
  following the recipe-preset convention) or `presets/instruments/pluck.yaml` (new)
- `src/instruments/index.ts` (register family)
- `src/instruments/presets.test.ts` (new; per-preset snapshot tests)

## Notes

Depends on F6 (determinism snapshot fixture pattern) and F7 (browser-safe layering).

# Instruments module documentation

**Parent:** TF-0MV9PIBNV008C00R (Playable MIDI instruments)
**Type:** docs

## Goal

Document the new instruments capability: API, message types, mapping formulas,
envelope semantics, voice-stealing policy, determinism guarantees, Node and
browser usage.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A module doc (e.g. `docs/modules/instruments.md`, or the repo's
  module-index convention) documents: the `noteOn` / `noteOff` API and message
  types; note→Hz and velocity→gain formulas; ADSR semantics; the configurable
  voice limit and the stealing policy; determinism guarantees; Node and browser
  usage examples.
- README and any module index are updated to link the new module.
- Docs state the scope boundary: programmatic API only (no raw MIDI bytes, no
  Web MIDI hardware binding, no MIDI file playback in this item), mirroring the
  intake decisions.
- All examples are runnable/reference the shipped API only (no invented
  options).

**Key Files:**

- `docs/modules/instruments.md` (new)
- `./README.md` (docs index entry)
- `docs/modules/index.md` (module index entry — extend the existing index)

## Notes

Depends on F8 (final preset set/API nailed down). Completes the "all related
documentation updated" AC.

# End-to-end verification and full-suite gate

**Parent:** TF-0MV9PIBNV008C00R (Playable MIDI instruments)
**Type:** task

## Goal

Bind the whole epic together: exercise the full vertical slice end-to-end
(chords, melodies, sustain/release, polyphony, dual runtime) via the public API
and confirm the entire project suite passes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- An integration test drives a realistic interactive sequence through the public
  API: a held note, a 3-note chord, an over-limit staccato passage, a same-note
  retrigger — rendered offline with a deterministic seed, asserting non-silence,
  expected pitches, release-to-silence, polyphony and no growth beyond the voice
  limit.
- The integration scenario runs against at least one instrument with an
  overridden `maxVoices` to prove the limit is honoured end-to-end.
- Full project test suite passes (per the test skill / CI gating) with the new
  module included.
- All six automated-review stages of the parent plan are consistent with the
  implemented behaviour (no drift between plan ACs and shipped behaviour).

**Key Files:**

- `src/instruments/integration.test.ts` (new)
- `./vitest.config.ts` (extend existing suite entrypoints only if needed)

## Notes

Depends on F8. Final gate before parent `in_review`.
data.title: End-to-end verification and full-suite gate
